article.detail:
Canto發布Global Assistant，將素材準備與AI素材分發兩條工作流程內置於數碼資產管理（DAM）平台。

Library Health可指出缺少替代文字、權利資料或產品圖片等待處理項目。

公司表示可依描述建立品牌素材分享入口；批量內容修改須由用戶確認，變更會留紀錄。

品牌及電商團隊可把素材完整度納入上架檢查，減少不同渠道重複找圖與核對版本。

先以一組已批准產品素材盤點缺漏，再確認權利資料、變更權限及分享入口審批。

官方頁面標示10月26日，新聞稿內文日期較頁面遲一天；本刊保留頁面日期。能力屬公司說明，未重現效率數字。
article.detail_en:
Canto announced Global Assistant, embedding content-readiness and AI asset-distribution workflows in its digital asset management platform.

Library Health identifies missing alt text, rights information or linked product imagery.

The company describes branded sharing portals from prompts, user confirmation for bulk changes and logged edits.

Brand and ecommerce teams can assess asset completeness before channel distribution and review version consistency.

Audit one approved product collection, then verify rights metadata, edit permissions and portal approval.

The page is dated October 26 while its dateline is one day later. We retain the page date; efficiency claims were not reproduced.
